messages:
sara: Quick sync  let's run a 2.5h copy sprint Tue to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero + 3 bullets + CTA, webinar landing, and inbound routing. goal: ship 2 hero variants for A/B and a webinar-first launch post.

leo: +1. Can we include a tiny benchmark slide for the launch post (latency vs cost)?

anya: yes  i'll prepare a one-slide benchmark and 2 customer quotes.

julia: propose timeboxes: 25m hero, 40m body/proof, 25m webinar landing & CTA, 25m form routing + UTMs, 15m wrap.

matt: inbound routing rule draft: collect Use Case, Team Size, Compliance checkbox, Expected RPS. if team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; use_case==evaluation -> webinar nurture; else -> demo queue. add utm_campaign=tri-mode-site.

sara: hero axes to test: latency, cost clarity, deployment flexibility. leo draft headlines?

leo: roughs:
- Hosted: "Get started in minutes  production-ready inference"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity, SLA-backed performance"
- Private: "Run inference on your network, enterprise controls"

anya: tweak Hosted to be PLG: "Start in minutes  enterprise-grade inference". Dedicated: emphasize economics: "Predictable throughput, lower unit cost at scale".

matt: i'll map the HubSpot fields and draft the workflow. also add demo confirmation tracking snippet.

content-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before. use template `./copy/briefs/site-launch-brief.md`.

sara: action owners: leo (hero headlines + 2 launch-post angles), anya (benchmarks + slides), matt (HubSpot routing + tracking), julia (facilitator + notes), sara (final sign-off). pre-read due Mon 5pm PT.

leo: for launch-post angles: 1) benchmark-first for dev channels, 2) customer-story for socials. will draft both.

anya: i'll include a chart showing batching lowers cost by ~30% at realistic seq lengths.

sara: perfect. we'll iterate copy in the sprint and aim to finalize by end of week. thanks! :clap:
